description.content:
Returns all resources of an enterprise associated with the connector integration. Note that when any of the extents is set to `true`, the response contains the entities that are associated to a resource. If the extent is not associated to a resource (e.g. resource category not assigned to any resource), this information is not returned.
Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

description.content: Returns the occupancy state of the specified resources. This operation returns the occupancy state for the current day. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
